contract: Canonical Knowledge bookmarks and manual collections provide ordered link buckets. Guarded public GitHub or GitLab archive snapshots land under the captured runtime home and produce durable revision-bound repository study notes without a second knowledge store.
acceptance: Create, rename, order and delete link buckets through canonical manual collections; persist exact link order and preserve bookmark items when a bucket is deleted.
Canonicalize and deduplicate credential-free HTTP(S) links; reorder operations validate the exact current identity set atomically and reject caller-selected homes or paths.

Accept only credential-free HTTPS GitHub or GitLab repository identities and acquire metadata plus archive bytes through the pinned-IP egress client with fixed-host validation before the initial request and every redirect.
Safely extract bounded snapshots under the captured runtime home, reject traversal, links, oversized entries and ambiguous roots, and report the actual immutable revision and checkout handle.
Persist durable ordered repository stages and honest failed or interrupted state; request replay is immutable and never fabricates external success.
Study actual landed files into a structured revision, file count, bytes, languages, top-level entries, README excerpt and risk notes plus one readable canonical Knowledge report note.
Actual HTTP and DOM consumers exercise bucket organization, persistent order, preservation receipts and guarded repository refusal.
remaining_limits: External success depends on public GitHub or GitLab availability and session egress; local qualification proves the real archive extraction, checkout study, canonical persistence, HTTP and DOM paths without claiming a live external repository transfer.
Repository snapshots are bounded read-only source archives, not mutable Git working copies; branch selection, credentials, pushes and arbitrary forge hosts are outside this task.
Study output is deterministic source inventory and README evidence, not model-authored architectural judgment.
Central handler registration and shared Knowledge navigation are integrated by the root lane.
